svg.text: The system block of simp-agent — one complete picture
Blocks = what happens. Cards on the arrows = the data passed between steps. Purple tags = book chapter + code.
PATH A → the terminal app, one user, one folder
PATH B → the server: a command goes in
← COMING BACK — model calls are guarded, events are saved and streamed
Test + run — wraps the whole system (Ch26)
FakeLLM (fakellm.py · stream): answers based on the last message (echo, tool, slow), so tests need no API key.
fake.py: the whole server with fake events. Playwright tests (apps/web/e2e) click the real web UI.
ops.py: JSON logs (JsonFormatter) and a safe copy of the database (backup).
deploy/launchd: two macOS services — run the server, and back it up every day.
